title: orders-api upstream error ratio above objective
body: Alert orders-api-upstream-errors fired at 22:05:36Z. Requests failing with upstream_unreachable reached 0.22 of traffic against an objective of 0.01. Alert cleared at 22:41:12Z.

title: resolver cache misses and SERVFAIL
body: resolver-2 (host clock, see chat-6620): repeated SERVFAIL responses for inventory.internal beginning at the timestamp recorded here. 40 to 70 failures per second sustained for roughly thirty minutes.

title: orders-api upstream connection failures
body: orders-api: connections to inventory.internal failing with name resolution error beginning 22:05:31Z. This host's clock is NTP-synchronised and was within 40ms of reference throughout.

title: resolution recovers
body: orders-api: name resolution for inventory.internal succeeding again from 22:41:05Z. Upstream error ratio returned to 0.004.

title: resolver-2 configuration reload
body: Configuration reload applied to resolver-2 at 22:04:50Z, forty-six seconds before alert-2280. The reload replaced an upstream forwarder address. The change record does not state whether the replacement address was reachable.

title: sampled failing order trace
body: Trace 7b19dd: POST /v1/orders total 84ms. Span inventory.lookup 12ms error, name resolution failed. No connection was established, so no upstream span exists.

title: responder reads resolver logs as following the errors
body: Responder L: 'The resolver only starts logging SERVFAIL at 22:12, but orders-api was already failing at 22:05. So the resolver is reacting to something upstream, not causing it.'

title: responder reports resolver clock skew
body: Responder M: 'resolver-2 lost NTP sync on 2026-05-24 and its clock runs approximately seven minutes and nine seconds fast. Its log timestamps are ahead of real time by that amount. The 22:12:40Z SERVFAIL line therefore corresponds to about 22:05:31Z real time, which is when orders-api started failing, not after it.'

title: mitigation and remaining question
body: Responder M: 'Reverted the forwarder address on resolver-2 at 22:40:30Z and resolution recovered. Nobody has established why the replacement forwarder address was unreachable, or whether it was ever validated before the reload.'

title: INC-6602 opened
body: INC-6602 opened at 22:09:00Z, severity 2, title 'Orders failing intermittently'. The ticket records no count of failed orders and none was added before resolution.

title: INC-6602 resolution note
body: INC-6602 marked resolved. Resolution note reads 'DNS issue, reverted config'. It does not record the resolver clock skew, so a later reader comparing raw log timestamps would reach the same wrong ordering.
